use std::sync::{LazyLock, Mutex, OnceLock, RwLock};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

static LAZY_CALLS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static ONCE_CALLS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static COUNTER: LazyLock<Mutex<usize>> = LazyLock::new(init_counter);
static PAIR: RwLock<(usize, usize)> = RwLock::new((0, 0));
static PAYLOAD: OnceLock<Box<[usize]>> = OnceLock::new();

fn init_counter() -> Mutex<usize> {
    LAZY_CALLS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    Mutex::new(0)
}

pub fn worker() -> usize {
    let payload = PAYLOAD.get_or_init(|| {
        ONCE_CALLS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        vec![13usize, 29, 47].into_boxed_slice()
    });
    assert_eq!(payload[0] + payload[1] + payload[2], 89);
    for _ in 0..1000 {
        *COUNTER.lock().unwrap() += 1;
        {
            let mut pair = PAIR.write().unwrap();
            pair.0 += 1;
            pair.1 = pair.0 * 2;
        }
        let first = PAIR.read().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first.1, first.0 * 2);
    }
    89
}

pub fn totals() -> usize {
    assert_eq!(LAZY_CALLS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    assert_eq!(ONCE_CALLS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    assert_eq!(*COUNTER.lock().unwrap(), 8000);
    let pair = PAIR.read().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(pair.0, 8000);
    assert_eq!(pair.1, 16000);
    pair.0 + pair.1
}

fn main() {
    let _: fn() -> usize = worker;
    let _: fn() -> usize = totals;
}
